stages.title: Pilot admission and fail-closed ledger
notes: Ledger v2 distinguishes not-created from corrupt; a damaged/forged/incomplete ledger never becomes zero credit. Reservations use the adapter's declared whole-turn bound, are serialized, and replay idempotently. A missing adapter, version drift, stale isolation/session/material evidence or a missing main admission blocks every send; price alone grants nothing.

stages.title: Eight-case three-arm bounded pilot
notes: Real execute chain remains implemented but BLOCKED on adapter_missing; 0/24 turns, no sample replacement, no ID-swap resend.

stages.title: Context and proposal product loop
notes: Existing decisions/attention/outcome negatives stay; context/proposal entries are added only after main publishes them, on real authenticated HTTP/SQLite.

stages.title: Two-binary installation and upgrade
notes: Same-byte wave-06 artifact remains accepted; wave-07 needs two frozen different binaries, release.json initialization under PA_CONFIG_ROOT and data compatibility across upgrade/rollback.

stages.title: Recovery authorization windows and bounded stability
notes: Read-only inspect/prepare verified; the commit, target half-preparation, activation pointer switch and unknown-writer barriers stay NOT_TESTED until main publishes the entry. Bounded cycles only.

stages.title: Layered conclusions and handoff
